standard.coverage: All covered employers, regardless of size.
standard.note: Third step of 2024 Ballot Measure 1: $13.00 on 2025-07-01, $14.00 on 2026-07-01, $15.00 on 2027-07-01, then annual inflation adjustment. Alaska's step date is July 1, not January 1 -- a January-only refresh cycle will carry a stale Alaska rate for six months of every year.

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Alaska Stat. 23.10.065 bars counting tips toward the minimum wage.

indexation.note: Inflation indexing resumes AFTER the legislated $15.00 step on 2027-07-01.

scheduledChanges.note: Final legislated step of Ballot Measure 1 (2024).
